description: The Governor of Maharashtra, Shri Jishnu Dev Varma, released the AI Governance Report 2026 by O.P. Jindal Global University in Mumbai. Congratulating the Cyril Shroff Centre for AI, Law &...
body_lead: The Governor emphasised the importance of AI in governance, stating that while AI can solve several problems, it also brings challenges. He stressed that AI must be used with compassion, ensuring last-mile delivery and upliftment of the masses. He further highlighted the need to preserve values, noting that technology without purpose can be dangerous, and governance must be guided by empathy. He also underlined the importance of preserving Indian art, culture, and schools of thought as part of national identity.
